description: Consommation quotidienne brute is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données présente les courbes de consommation d’électricité (par demi-heure en MW) et de gaz (par heure en MW PCS 0°C). Périmètre électricité: France métropolitaine hors Corse. Les années 2012 à 2024 sont au statut définitif. Les données 2025 et 2026 est au statut consolidé. Périmètre gaz: France continentale. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Consommation. Its keywords are Article 179, LTECV. The portal shows 2026-05-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
